item.title: [LU-12552] sanity-sec test_17: cannot chmod trusted_noadmin
item.description:
This issue was created by maloo for Li Xi <pkuelelixi@gmail.com>

This issue relates to the following test suite run: https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sets/ada5bfee-a6e9-11e9-8fc1-52540065bddc

CMD: onyx-41vm3 /usr/sbin/lctl list_nids | grep tcp | cut -f 1 -d @
On onyx-41vm3 10.2.8.134, default.admin_nodemap = nodemap.default.admin_nodemap=1
CMD: onyx-41vm3 /usr/sbin/lctl list_nids | grep tcp | cut -f 1 -d @
On onyx-41vm3 10.2.8.134, default.admin_nodemap = nodemap.default.admin_nodemap=1
CMD: onyx-41vm3 /usr/sbin/lctl list_nids | grep tcp | cut -f 1 -d @
On onyx-41vm3 10.2.8.134, default.admin_nodemap = nodemap.default.admin_nodemap=0
CMD: onyx-41vm4 /usr/sbin/lctl list_nids | grep tcp | cut -f 1 -d @
CMD: onyx-41vm5 /usr/sbin/lctl list_nids | grep tcp | cut -f 1 -d @
On onyx-41vm5 10.2.8.136, default.admin_nodemap = nodemap.default.admin_nodemap=0
waited 2 seconds for sync
CMD: onyx-41vm4 /usr/sbin/lctl nodemap_modify --name default --property trusted --value 0
CMD: onyx-41vm4 /usr/sbin/lctl get_param -n nodemap.active
CMD: onyx-41vm4 /usr/sbin/lctl list_nids | grep tcp | cut -f 1 -d @
CMD: onyx-41vm4 /usr/sbin/lctl get_param nodemap.default.trusted_nodemap
On MGS 10.2.8.135, default.trusted_nodemap = nodemap.default.trusted_nodemap=0

On onyx-41vm3 10.2.8.134, default.trusted_nodemap = nodemap.default.trusted_nodemap=0
CMD: onyx-41vm4 /usr/sbin/lctl list_nids | grep tcp | cut -f 1 -d @
CMD: onyx-41vm5 /usr/sbin/lctl list_nids | grep tcp | cut -f 1 -d @
On onyx-41vm5 10.2.8.136, default.trusted_nodemap = nodemap.default.trusted_nodemap=0
waited 4 seconds for sync
CMD: onyx-41vm4 /usr/sbin/lctl nodemap_activate 0
CMD: onyx-41vm4 /usr/sbin/lctl get_param -n nodemap.active
CMD: onyx-41vm4 /usr/sbin/lctl list_nids | grep tcp | cut -f 1 -d @
CMD: onyx-41vm4 /usr/sbin/lctl get_param nodemap.active
On MGS 10.2.8.135, active = nodemap.active=0
